visual_action: A montage of video clips featuring President Joe Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris. They are shown walking together in the White House, on a lawn, and with former President Barack Obama. Biden is also seen smiling at a podium, signing a document in the Oval Office, and interacting with various groups of people, including a large group of cheering young people, factory workers in hard hats, and a woman at a facility with a "Made in America" sign. Harris is seen walking with another man. Overlaid on the clips are text boxes listing achievements of the administration.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Appears in nearly every clip of the montage.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Appears in multiple clips, often alongside Joe Biden.

cast.name: Barack Obama
cast.evidence: Shown walking alongside Joe Biden and Kamala Harris in one clip.

cast.name: Jill Biden
cast.evidence: Shown standing behind Joe Biden and clapping as he sits at a desk in one clip.

cast.name: Biden-Harris Administration
cast.evidence: The on-screen text "Biden-Harris 2023 wins🦆" and the subsequent list of accomplishments frame the entire video as being about the administration's performance.

on_screen_text.text: ✅ Canceled $132 billion in student loan debt for over 3.6 million Americans
✅ Established the White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention
✅ Record enrollment in the Affordable Care Act
✅ Lowered drug and health care costs
✅ Established the White House Initiative on Women's Health Research

spoken_summary: The video opens with a male announcer's voice saying, "And with that, the 2023 season comes to an end. Good night." The rest of the video is set to music with no further dialogue.
audio_music: The video begins with a spoken-word soundbite, then transitions into an upbeat, celebratory pop song with a slightly retro feel that continues for the remainder of the clip. The music serves to create a positive and energetic tone for the montage of achievements. The fingerprinted track is "Thank you 2023" by 蒋立凡.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between different scenes to showcase a variety of positive moments and policy achievements.
cultural_references: The audio clip at the beginning, "And with that, the 2023 season comes to an end. Good night," is a well-known soundbite from baseball announcer Vin Scully's final broadcast, which has become a popular meme sound on social media to signify the end of a period.
central_claim: The Biden-Harris administration achieved numerous significant policy wins in 2023 across the economy, healthcare, and social issues.
intended_effect: To make viewers feel proud of the administration's accomplishments and positive about its performance in 2023.
